results.title: Being Maria
results.overview: A young, struggling actress lands her dream role in a film by an emerging Italian director, starring alongside an American superstar. What begins as her big breakthrough quickly turns into a living hell.

results.title: Animale
results.overview: Camargue, France - Nejma trains hard to win the local bullfighting competition. When she is mauled after a celebration, she starts to notice disturbing changes. News of a rogue bull on the loose terrifies the community, killing young men.

results.title: Bad Genius
results.overview: A highly-gifted student sees an opportunity to escape her roots by helping wealthy classmates cheat on key exams, but at great risk to her future.

results.title: Kung Fu Games
results.overview: Notorious fighters are trapped in lethal martial arts games by a sadistic magnate. Armed only with their combat skills, they face brutal battles for survival in a deadly kill-or-be-killed showdown.

results.title: The Bridge
results.overview: Foued, a young director, helps his friend Tita by filming his hip-hop video. During a shooting scene with Safa, they find a packet of cocaine. They decide to sell it in small quantities at a trendy nightclub in Tunis. Every night, they cross the bridge. But things take an unexpected turn.

results.title: Toots.
results.overview: When his aging mother's health declines due to Parkinson's, a devoted son grapples with the challenges of becoming her caregiver.

results.title: Inevitable
results.overview: Two former best friends find a time machine inside a retro video game, leading them to reconsider their past and, more importantly, their friendship.

results.title: It All Comes with the Cold Water
results.original_title: It All Comes with the Cold Water
results.overview: When a young couple finds their love tested to the limits and whispers of infidelity grow louder, their delicate balance between love and career begins to crumble, forcing them to question whether they're truly meant to be together.

results.title: Malu
results.overview: Malu — a mercurial, unemployed actress living with her conservative mother in a precarious house in a Rio de Janeiro slum — tries to deal with her strained relationship with her own adult daughter while surviving on memories of her glorious artistic past.

results.title: Munjya
results.overview: A young man's visit to his native village unveils a family secret and a vengeful spirit, Munjya, who wants to get married. Now the young man must fight to protect himself and his love from Munjya's clutches leading to a humorously chaotic and terrifying adventure.

results.title: Swap
results.overview: A young couple is lured into the clutches of a bloodthirsty 500-year-old vampire; the exotic stranger tries to persuade them to swap partners and join his kind.

results.title: A Part of You
results.overview: A teenager struggles to pick up the pieces of her shattered world in this emotional and bittersweet coming-of-age drama about those who are left behind.

results.title: Reyes secretos
results.overview: ​​In the Unidad Vecinal Portales, also known as Villa Portales, a group of teenagers who have been friends for years, live together united by skateboarding. Through their conversations we delve into their humor and what is important to them, their uncomfortable opinions and what really unites them as men and friends.

results.title: The Red Virgin
results.overview: Hildegart is conceived and educated by her mother Aurora to be the woman of the future, to become one of the most brilliant minds of Spain in the 1930s and one of the European references on female sexuality.

results.title: Hearts of Bali
results.overview: Three women, three generations, one island... an island to fall in love with! After the death of her Indian grandmother, influencer Jenny convinces her mother and sister to go to Bali with her. They are completely different and each of the women come to the island with their own motivation and questions. While Jenny tries to save her career, Dewi mainly wants to look for her roots and Cornelie hopes that the journey will bring her and her daughters closer together. Through the search for a family legend, not only an old love story unfolds amid the colorful Indonesian culture, but new loves unexpectedly arise.

results.title: Recital
results.overview: What are we looking at? We can perhaps discern from the greyscale fuzz, the varying degrees of white patches, fanning out from a point in shapes hard to parse, that this is an ultrasound display. But what are we trying to see in the scan? There is no baby or foetal development, no heart, no kidney, no liver, no needle to pierce through the night like a ship. But it moves in time with a voiceover. A mouth, surely? Yes. We are, quite literally, mechanically, watching someone speak.

results.title: Boss Ma'am
results.overview: V.A.D. and Charm try to outplay each other in a game of deceit. When a terror female boss was blackmailed by her assistant, she has no choice but to obey and play with her.

results.title: Monster on a Plane
results.overview: An exotic animal turns into a monster and becomes a deadly danger for all passengers.

results.title: Peluang Ketiga
results.overview: Zulaikha and Yusuf have been in a relationship since their university days. However, their relationship breaks apart when Yusuf disagrees with Zulaikha's decision to become a singer. Zulaikha then meets Mikhail, a noble-hearted man who always supports all of her dreams. Meanwhile, Yusuf continues his career as a professional cyclist and falls in love with a sports journalist named Alya. However, when Mikhail proposes to Zulaikha, Yusuf's heart begins to be seized by jealousy. Will Yusuf be able to forget Zulaikha and accept the fact that their love may have already passed?
